newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARMSTRONG FACES OPERATION ON INJURED ANKLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARMSTRONG FACES OPERATION ON INJURED ANKLE.

text.p: Chris Armstrong, Tottenham's most expensive buy, faces an operation on Monday after being told his damaged ankle will not respond to treatment.
Armstrong, who cost Spurs 4.5 million pounds ($7.5 million), has been troubled by the ankle since being stretchered off during a premier league match against Everton in August.
He has made several comeback attempts since then and remains Spurs' joint top scorer with six goals, but the problem, identified as tendonitis, has refused to go away.

"We've tried continuous treatment on Chris as he did not want to miss games but now it is time for the injury to be dealt with in hospital," Spurs physio Tony Lanaghan said. He is expected to be sidelined for six weeks.
